iti104:2.1: bahūpakāraṁ → bahukāraṁ (sya-all) | bhikkhū sīlasampannā → bhikkhu sīla sampannā (pts) | paññāsampannā → Om. P. Pa. (pts note) | vimuttiñāṇadassanasampannā → Om. B. C. P. Pa. (pts note) | viññāpakā → After viññ-, P. Pa. insert adhabodhakā, for avabodhakā, a gloss from A. (pts note) | samādapakā → -pikā, B. (pts note) | samuttejakā → -jikā, B. (pts note) | sampahaṁsakā → -sikā, B. (pts note) | alaṁsamakkhātāro → salaṁsamattakā, C.; alaṁsammattakā (pts note) | saddhammassa → saddassa, C.; om. D. E.; after saddh- P. Pa. insert desetāro, a gloss from A. (pts note) | dassanam-pahaṁ → pahaṁ, which occurs six times in this sutta, is for api ahaṁ; B. has always ahaṁ without p; in C. D. E. M. the preceding accusative has always the anusvāra; dassanaṁ sahaṁ, C. (pts note) | bahūpakāraṁ → Only C. has nearly always bahūp-, the other MSS. have bahu-; D. E. have always bahukāraṁ; also C. the first time. (pts note)
iti104:2.3: bahūpakāraṁ → bahukāraṁ (sya-all) | upasaṅkamanam-pahaṁ → pahāna, C. (pts note)
iti104:2.8: aparipūropi paññākkhandho → aparipūro pi paññakkhandho (pts) | bhajato → Om. C. (pts note) | payirupāsato → parirup-, B. Pa. (pts note) | bhāvanāpāripūriṁ → M. always -pūriṁ; B. C. P. Pa. always -pūri in this sutta. (pts note) | paññakkhandho → paññākkh- D. E. P. (pts note) | gacchati → D. E. omit this sentence. (pts note) | vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandho → -ññāṇa, P. Pa. (pts note)
iti104:2.9: te → Om. D. E. (pts note) | bhikkhū → The long ū only in M. (pts note) | satthāro → sattāro, C. (pts note) | satthavāhā → jātikantārādinittharaṇato sattavāhā ti, A.; sattavāho, C. P. Pa. (pts note) | raṇañjahā → -ho, C.; maraṇajahā, D. E. (pts note) | pi → Om. C. (pts note) | pi → ālokadivākarā vā ti v-, Pa., inserting it once more before pajjotak-. (pts note) | vuccanti → I follow A. M.; the other MSS. have pabh- before ukk-; ukkakarā, B.; pabhākaro, Pa. (pts note) | cakkhumanto → -mantā, B. C. (pts note)
iti104:2.10: Pāmujjakaraṇaṁ → pāmojja-, D. E.; pāmujjakaraṇa, B.; -karaṇaṭṭhāṇaṁ, C.; -kāraṇaṁ, P. Pa. (pts note)
